paragraph: On 20 July 2026 [the First Lady symbolically activated the Cadastro Social Único platform](<https://masfamu.gov.ao/home>), the registry set up by Presidential Decree 136/19. On 24 August 2026 [its pilot phase began in Sumbe municipality, Cuanza-Sul](<https://angop.ao/noticias/sociedade/cadastro-social-nico-inicia-fase-piloto-no-sumbe/>). In the last twelve months the registry was activated and piloted. In June 2024 [the World Bank counted 1,595,496 households registered for cash transfers](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102524042530084/pdf/P169779177dc6e0f518d2610fb44ed3049d.pdf>), while the unified registry was not yet operational. No source found says it is in service beyond Sumbe. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

In May 2026 [the World Bank said investments in a Unified Social Registry and CORE-MIS enable transparent targeting](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2026/05/01/building-burundi-s-national-social-protection-systems-to-deliver-jobs-and-respond-to-crises>). It said they had been used to identify over 100,000 flood- and food-crisis-affected households. In the last twelve months it also said [Merankabandi's Social Registry is used by the Soleil-Nyakiriza solar energy project](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2026/05/01/building-burundi-s-national-social-protection-systems-to-deliver-jobs-and-respond-to-crises>). No link to the national ID has been found. No programme drawing on the registry is shown paying benefits digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

In January 2026 [Le Matinal reported that the Conseil des ministres created the Registre Social Unique, an information system for eligibility decisions and household data](<https://lematinal.bj/registre-social-unique-au-benin-la-protection-des-plus-vulnerables-renforcee/>). It described the system as 'en cours de mise en place'. [ANIP/WURI-Benin reported a launch and scoping workshop for setting up the registry](<https://anip.bj/le-registre-social-unique-rsu-bientot-une-realite/>), financed by the World Bank WURI project. In the last twelve months the Council of Ministers created the registry. No source found says it is in service. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

By 30 June 2026 the solidarity minister put the Registre Social Unique at [433,888 households, over 2 million people, in 110 communes across 12 regions](<https://aesinsider.com/burkina-faso-plus-de-433-000-menages-recenses-dans-le-registre-social-unique/>). In the last twelve months the count rose from [362,698 households in 99 communes in December 2025](<https://www.sidwaya.info/registre-social-unique-le-burkina-faso-renforce-la-protection-sociale/>). The World Bank's new project, approved in June 2026, [continues its roll-out](<https://www.banquemondiale.org/fr/programs/sahel-adaptive-social-protection-program-trust-fund/country-work/burkina-faso>). No source found says two or more programmes select from the registry, or that it is linked to the national ID. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

In September 2026 [the social protection director said the Single Social Registry was 96 per cent complete and had captured 18 social protection programmes](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/93447>). In October 2026 [an official said the government was establishing the registry to identify and target the most vulnerable](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/93635>). In the last twelve months, in February 2026, [the finance minister called for its roll-out to be accelerated](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/89878>). By March 2025 [98 percent of beneficiaries of the five main social assistance programmes were in it](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099121825122532143/txt/BOSIB-35f31917-1454-433b-a021-4d7246073f71.txt>). No source found says the registry is in service. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

On 2 April 2026 the social safety nets office and the identity agency ONECI [signed a convention interconnecting the Registre Social Unique with ONECI's databases](<https://filetsociaux-ci.org/registre-social-unique-des-menages-pauvres-et-vulnerables-rsu-signature-dune-convention-entre-le-bureau-de-coordination-du-programme-filets-sociaux-bcpfs-et-loffice-nation/>). In the last twelve months this link was agreed. The aim is to remove duplicates. In April 2025 the same office said [more than 200,000 households were being registered](<https://filetsociaux-ci.org/operationnalisation-du-registre-social-unique-rsu-des-menages-pauvres-et-vulnerables-plus-de-200-000-menages-en-cours-denregistrement>). No source found names the programmes that select from the registry, or says benefits are paid digitally. Mature would need a programme drawing on the registry to pay benefits digitally, with the registry linked to the national ID.

[The World Bank says RESUC, under the Ministry of Social Affairs, covered 198,140 households by July 2025](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099082625105536477/pdf/BOSIB-c1db46ff-563d-4cc3-b382-1eb9e5eb6876.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Cameroon Tribune reported that in the Ouest region only 55,097 vulnerable people in eight communes were registered in RESUC](<https://www.cameroon-tribune.cm/article.html/76019/en.html/registre-social-unifie-les-acteurs-de-louest-sensibilises>). No source found says two or more programmes use the registry, or that it is linked to the national ID. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

[Decree n°25/041 of 4 December 2025 creates the Registre Social Unique (RSU), a socio-economic database to harmonise targeting of poor and vulnerable households](<https://leganews.pro/articles/019d2bef-1d56-70af-a0b8-79e76597706d>). In the last twelve months the decree was issued. [MINAS says the RSU provides lists of eligible households to the different social programmes, including State ones](<https://minas.gouv.cd/registre-social-unique-rsu-un-levier-essentiel-pour-la-protection-sociale-en-rdc/>), under data-sharing protocols. It registered about 465,883 households in 2020-2025. No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID, or that a programme drawing on it pays benefits digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

The social affairs ministry says the Registre Social Unique's [headquarters opened on 10 April 2026](<https://affaires-sociales.gouv.cg/2026/04/14/le-registre-social-unique-du-congo-dispose-dun-siege-approprie/>). In the last twelve months the minister said in April 2026 that [the assistance programmes now share it as a common source of information](<https://affaires-sociales.gouv.cg/2026/04/14/le-registre-social-unique-du-congo-dispose-dun-siege-approprie/>). In May 2025 the national safety net programme [selected the recipients of its conditional cash transfers from the registry](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/affaires-sociales-des-menages-vulnerables-recoivent-des-transferts-monetaires-164790>). An arrêté of 20 August 2024 says [the registry holds the unique identification number](<https://liziba.cg/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Arrete-n-18503-du-20-aout-2024-fixant-les-regles-de-collecte-de-traitement-dechange-et-dactualisation-des-donnees-du-registre-social-unique.pdf>). No source found says a programme drawing on the registry pays benefits digitally. Mature would need a programme drawing on the registry to pay benefits digitally.

In November 2026 [the PFSS-RRC said the Registre social unique held 81,075 households](<https://pfss-comores.org/articles/le-gouvernement-comorien-et-la-banque-mondiale-renforcent-leur-partenariat-autour-du-projet-mayendeleyo>). [It operated in 152 of the country's 319 localities](<https://pfss-comores.org/articles/le-gouvernement-comorien-et-la-banque-mondiale-renforcent-leur-partenariat-autour-du-projet-mayendeleyo>). In the last twelve months the count rose from [62,000 households, which the World Bank representative gave in July 2026](<https://lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/registre-social-unique-62-000-m%C3%A9nages-d%C3%A9j%C3%A0-enregistr%C3%A9s-.html>). No source found says two or more programmes choose recipients from the registry, or that it is linked to the national ID. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

The Cabo Verde minister says [the Cadastro Social Único, implemented in 2017, is in use](<https://www.governo.cv/governo-lanca-mecanismo-de-gestao-das-informacoes-e-reclamacoes-do-cadastro-social-unico/>). About 59% of households and 66% of the population are classified and validated nationally. The minister says [about 16 social programmes use the CSU to select beneficiaries](<https://www.governo.cv/governo-lanca-mecanismo-de-gestao-das-informacoes-e-reclamacoes-do-cadastro-social-unico/>). In the last twelve months, in June 2026, [the government invited households in climate-vulnerable zones to register](<https://www.governo.cv/apelo-ao-registo-no-cadastro-social-unico-csu-para-agregados-familiares-em-zonas-climaticamente-vulneraveis/>). No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID, or that a programme pays benefits digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

[The World Bank project record says Djibouti's national Social Registry is housed at the Ministry of Social Affairs and Solidarities](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P506969>). It had 515,730 people registered as of February 2025, with a target of 600,000. In the last twelve months it was cited and not changed. In January 2026 [President Guelleh said a poverty mapping was established thanks to the social registry](<https://www.adds.dj/en/president-guelleh-reiterates-his-commitment-to-dedicating-a-central-component-of-his-policy-to-the-fight-against-poverty/>). No source found says two or more programmes use the registry, or that it is linked to the national ID. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

In May 2024 the World Bank said the Takaful and Karama programme's registry [held about 11.3 million households, 40.5 million people](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, Raafat Shafik of the Ministry of Social Solidarity said [the registry holds data on 13 million households](<https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/764443/>). He said [it is linked to 27 government databases through the national ID number](<https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/764443/>). In August 2026 the ministry said [Social Security Law 12 of 2025 made the registry the single source for every cash-transfer beneficiary database](<https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4343435>). In 2025 the World Bank's Stephane Guimbert said [Takaful and Karama pays benefits digitally through Meeza cards](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/547276.aspx>). No source found says what share of its payments go to cards. None says whether the other programmes using the registry pay digitally.

OpenG2P told ID4Africa in 2025 that [the Ministry of Women and Social Affairs is setting up a National Social Registry](<https://id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P1-S2-OpenG2P-Final.pdf>). [A pilot had registered 821 people in Addis Ababa](<https://id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P1-S2-OpenG2P-Final.pdf>). OpenG2P says [it seeded its social registry with Fayda IDs issued by the National ID Program](<https://id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P1-S2-OpenG2P-Final.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a social registry is in service, or that two or more programmes choose recipients from one. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

On 29 July 2026 [the Ministry of Social Affairs presented the first deliverable of the unified social registry (RSUG)](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-protection-sociale-presentation-du-premier-livrable-du-registre-social-unifie-et-du-programme-dacces-aux-agr/>). Its stated aim is to set up the registry. In the last twelve months [the ministry and World Bank experts reviewed progress on implementing the Registre social unique at a 7 May 2026 meeting](<https://financesao.com/gabon-le-registre-social-unique-avance-avec-lappui-de-la-banque-mondiale/>). The registry is a centralised national database meant to identify the most vulnerable households. No source found says it is in service. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

In November 2026 the gender ministry said the Ghana National Household Registry [holds about three million households across all 16 regions](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/gender-ministry-swears-in-data-review-committee-to-strengthen-household-registry/>). The registry [targets beneficiaries of LEAP, school feeding and national health insurance](<https://gnhr.mogcsp.gov.gh/registry.php>). In the last twelve months, its privacy policy of July 2026 says it [collects each person's Ghana Card number and links its data with the identity authority's databases](<https://gnhr.mogcsp.gov.gh/privacy.php>). No source found says LEAP, or another programme drawing on the registry, pays benefits digitally. Mature would need a programme drawing on the registry to pay benefits digitally, with the registry linked to the national ID.

In July 2026 [the director general of the FDSI said teams had covered the whole country](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/07/guinee-le-fdsi-presente-le-rapport-danalyse-du-registre-social-unifie-qui-cartographie-977-610-menages-soit-4-860-075-individus-a-travers-le-pays/>). [The Registre Social Unifié (RSU) then held 977,610 households and 4,860,075 individuals](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/07/guinee-le-fdsi-presente-le-rapport-danalyse-du-registre-social-unifie-qui-cartographie-977-610-menages-soit-4-860-075-individus-a-travers-le-pays/>). In the last twelve months, [RSU data served the Guichet Choc Alimentaire project](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/07/guinee-le-fdsi-presente-le-rapport-danalyse-du-registre-social-unifie-qui-cartographie-977-610-menages-soit-4-860-075-individus-a-travers-le-pays/>), run by ANIES and the IMF. It had also served UNICEF's follow-up of malnourished children. No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID, or that a programme drawing on it pays benefits digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

In April 2024 [the World Bank said the Gambia Social Registry (GamSR), begun in 2021, covered 203,022 households](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/nasikiliza/the-gambia-social-registry-a-success-story-in-systems-building>). It also said [GamSR data underpinned the Nafa Quick COVID-19 response, for 78,422 households](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/nasikiliza/the-gambia-social-registry-a-success-story-in-systems-building>). In May 2025 [the National Social Protection Secretariat said the registry, held on the SRIS platform, had collected household data in all regions except Kanifing and Banjul](<https://dpi.africa/from-data-to-impact-the-digital-transformation-of-the-gambias-social-registry/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID, or that a programme drawing on it pays benefits digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

[Ley 5/2026, promulgated in April 2026, creates a Registro Único Social within the Instituto de Protección Social](<https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/eqg248009.pdf>), to hold data on people who receive or could receive non-contributory benefits. [The law takes effect six months after publication](<https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/eqg248009.pdf>). In the last twelve months the law of April 2026 created the registry. No source found says the registry has been built, has enrolled households or is in service, or that any programme uses it. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

In August 2025 [the KSEIP 2 environmental and social management plan said all National Safety Net Programme cash transfers use the Enhanced Single Registry](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/ESMP%20Template-August%202025%20(3).pdf>). [These are the HSNP, OPCT, CT-OVC and PwSD-CT](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/ESMP%20Template-August%202025%20(3).pdf>). In the last twelve months, in June 2026, [the World Bank said its programme supports the registry as the main platform for identifying social-assistance beneficiaries](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2026/06/30/world-bank-supports-kenyas-push-for-stronger-accountability-and-social-protection>). No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID, or that a programme drawing on it pays benefits digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

In May 2024 [the World Bank said more than 250,000 households, about 20 percent of the population, were enrolled in the Liberia Household Social Registry](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/africacan/a-strong-foundation-for-adaptive-social-protection-in-liberia>). It said [three government-led social protection programmes use the registry and the MIS](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/africacan/a-strong-foundation-for-adaptive-social-protection-in-liberia>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026, [the REALISE Project page said the registry is operational](<https://realise.liberiasp.gov.lr/2026/05/18/government-of-liberia-presents-crisis-response-plan-to-world-bank/>). It holds verified, poverty-ranked records for over 442,000 households. No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID. None says a programme drawing on it pays benefits digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

In October 2023 [UNICEF Libya announced that the Tripoli-based government had launched the Unified Social Registry](<https://libyaherald.com/2023/10/unicef-helps-launch-libyas-unified-social-registry-for-children>). On 22 June 2025 [Prime Minister Dabaiba approved the draft Unified Social Registry document](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=335044&lang=en>), which sets out a unified database of citizens' social and economic data. [LANA described it on 23 June 2025 as a project](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?lang=en&id=335111>) to identify those eligible for support. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the registry is in service. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

NISSA is the national social registry. It [held 488,000 households, 90% of the country's, across all 10 districts in April 2024](<https://selibeng.com/eoi-lesotho-nissa-systems-development-enhancement-consultancy/>). In August 2024 the ministry [sought proposals for the NISSA registry and its management information system](<https://lesotho.un.org/en/274430-request-proposals-national-information-system-social-assistance-nissa-social-registry-and>), with EU money and UNICEF support. No change has been found in the last twelve months. The ministry describes NISSA as [a common entry point used to target households for various programmes](<https://selibeng.com/eoi-lesotho-nissa-systems-development-enhancement-consultancy/>). It names none of them. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

In November 2025 [the government said enrolment yields a household score from 35 urban or 28 rural variables, under Law 72.18](<https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2025/12/272839/morocco-expands-direct-social-support-with-measured-data-driven-reform/>). It named direct cash transfers and basic health insurance as programmes that use the RSU. In the last twelve months, [Le Matin reported that 2026-27 university grants are also awarded on the RSU household score](<https://lematin.ma/enseignement/bac-2026-les-demandes-de-bourse-sur-minhaty-sont-ouvertes/356597>). [ANSS's report for 2025 says direct aid is targeted by crossing the RSU with the national population register](<https://www.lebrief.ma/soutien-social-un-an-apres-impact-de-lanss-100155241/>). No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

In September 2026 [Newsmada reported that Madagascar's Registre social unique covers about 2.7 million households, close to 12 million people](<https://newsmada.com/2026/09/10/protection-sociale-le-rsu-elargit-son-filet/>). In the last twelve months [eight more districts have been joining the 20 already covered](<https://newsmada.com/2026/09/10/protection-sociale-le-rsu-elargit-son-filet/>). A new survey is under way to update the data. [L'Express reports a mass registration campaign in 99 districts until December 2026, aiming at national coverage](<https://www.lexpress.mg/2026/05/recensement-26-millions-de-menages.html>). No source found says two or more programmes use the registry, or that it is linked to the national ID. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

In April 2024 [the World Bank said the RSU covered 1.2 million households](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099031425101035349/pdf/P500480-8589b096-9644-4127-863d-00895a97c3d8.pdf>). [In 2025 it was used to target the national food insecurity response, WFP says](<https://docs.wfp.org/api/documents/WFP-0000172581/download/>). In the last twelve months, in February 2026, [WFP was financing data collection in 14 food-insecure communes to add 3,000 households](<https://docs.wfp.org/api/documents/WFP-0000172581/download/>). No source found says a second programme uses the registry, or that it is linked to the national ID. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

In May 2026 [a World Bank project document said Additional Financing 1 supports the legal and technical establishment of the National Social Registry](<https://www.gtai.de/resource/blob/1999512/d5f145dad744ac85e8c8fd6d42f16a49/PRO202605201999506.pdf>). [The registry is to be built by consolidating the current database through data cleaning and collection](<https://www.gtai.de/resource/blob/1999512/d5f145dad744ac85e8c8fd6d42f16a49/PRO202605201999506.pdf>). [New beneficiaries are to be registered in it](<https://www.gtai.de/resource/blob/1999512/d5f145dad744ac85e8c8fd6d42f16a49/PRO202605201999506.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says the registry is in service, in the last twelve months or before. Establishing would need a social registry in service.

Decree 2024-073 of 15 May 2024 sets the rules. [Poor households in the registry are eligible for Tekavoul regular transfers](<https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/mau229659.pdf>), and vulnerable households in it for shock-response transfers. In the last twelve months, on 21 August 2026, [an IDA financing was signed to strengthen the Registre social](<https://lequotidien.mr/?p=43058>). Taazour says [2,057,006 citizens in the registry can check their eligibility on its platform](<https://taazour.mr/archives/7559>). No source found since October 2023 says the registry is linked to the national ID, or that benefits are paid digitally. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

In January 2026 the Mauritius Revenue Authority said [people on the Social Register keep receiving CSG income allowances at the June 2025 rates](<https://www.mra.mu/download/FAQs-SocialContributionIncomeAllowance.pdf>). Since the 2025-26 budget, [youths on the Social Register receive the Rs 20,000 Independence Allowance at 18](<https://www.mra.mu/index.php/eservices1/financial-assistance/independence-allowance>). In the last twelve months, in April 2026, the social integration ministry listed [three schemes for register households](<https://socialintegration.govmu.org/Pages/About%20Us/Schemes.aspx>). They are the Subsistence Allowance, Bread Price Relief and Child Allowance. Nothing found says the register is linked to the national ID. Mature would need the register linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

In March 2025 [a World Bank mission said the Unified Beneficiary Registry, also called the Malawi Social Registry, held 4.2 million households](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099062325114042048/txt/P169198-441cfc05-221d-412e-9c5e-a5b191e1d0bb.txt>). [It said five programmes use the registry's data for targeting and research](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099062325114042048/txt/P169198-441cfc05-221d-412e-9c5e-a5b191e1d0bb.txt>). In the last twelve months, in June 2026, [a Ministry of Finance principal economist called it a vital tool for delivering social programmes](<https://mwnation.com/ministry-touts-new-social-registry-tool/>). He spoke at a workshop on moving it from a static to a dynamic database. No source found says the registry is linked to the national ID. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and a programme drawing on it paying benefits digitally.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether a social registry is under way or in service. The rows held for Namibia date from 2022, which is older than three years, so they do not place the country. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says a social registry is procured, piloted or being populated in some districts. Preparing would need a social registry procured, piloted or being populated in some districts.

In October 2026 [the Registre Social Unifié-Niger, run from the Prime Minister's office, was described as an information system holding household and individual data](<https://rsu.gouv.ne/presentation>). In the last twelve months it was also described as the entry point for programmes. UNICEF's social policy section chief said [more than 500,000 vulnerable households have been registered](<https://www.lesahel.org/formation-des-cadres-nationaux-du-systeme-de-protection-sociale-du-niger-pour-la-mise-en-place-dun-systeme-durable-coherent-et-fonde-sur-les-droits-humains/>). [The registry is not yet deployed across the whole country and suffers update delays](<https://www.actuniger.com/societe/21295-protection-sociale-au-niger-lancement-dune-feuille-de-route-pour-un-systeme-plus-juste-inclusif-et-resilient.html>). No source found says two or more programmes use it, or that it is linked to the national ID. Operating would need two or more social programmes choosing recipients from the registry, or a link to the national ID.

In October 2026 NASSCO said the National Social Register [held 21.1 million households and 83.2 million people](<https://punchng.com/fg-links-15-6m-nigerians-to-nin-in-social-register/>). It said [the national ID numbers of 15.65 million people had been integrated into the register](<https://punchng.com/fg-links-15-6m-nigerians-to-nin-in-social-register/>).
